task: SGLang server smoke test (final gate for sgl-kernel wheel fix) - launch real SGLang server on port 19011 in WSL (no docker) with the pre-installed fixed sgl-kernel wheel, prove /health + /v1/models + one tiny chat completion, teardown, record evidence.

environment.runtime: WSL2 only (no docker); WSL distro reports Fedora-style linux; launcher runs under bash via wsl.exe
environment.sgl_kernel: 0.1.0 (fixed wheel, pre-installed, NOT modified by this test)
environment.transformers: new (encode/apply_chat_template return Encoding/BatchEncoding; batch-level BatchEncoding __getitem__ semantics)
environment.compat_shims: 14 in-memory monkey-patches in ephemeral launcher (no wheel/repo/lane file modified): 1=triton 2.x cache API, 2=numpy.lib.function_base alias, 3=pyairports stub, 4=flashinfer grouped-size capability stub, 5=vllm model_loader.loader alias, 6=11 vllm quantization module stubs, 7=vllm custom_all_reduce_utils stub, 8=vllm config-context for initialize_model_parallel, 9=ModelConfig tokenizer_mode/tokenizer fix, 10=LinearBase old-style positional remap (bias param), 11=get_rope kwargs->rope_parameters translation, 12=global default vllm config, 13=profile_max_num_token floor >=512, 14=tokenizer encode + apply_chat_template -> list-of-ints wrap at tokenizer creation (patched hf_transformers_utils AND tokenizer_manager module bindings)

gpu.note: Windows nvidia-smi order: index 0 = GTX 1080 Ti (sm_61, unsupported by torch), index 1 = RTX 3090 Ti (sm_86). WSL/torch order REVERSED: RTX 3090 Ti = torch device 0. Smoke server ran on torch device 0. GTX 1080 Ti not used.

gpu_memory.note: WSL GPU-PV reports far more free memory than host nvidia-smi because lane vLLM services (granite 19002, LFM2.5 19600, proxy 21080) run in a separate VM/host partition; host nvidia-smi is authoritative for the shared-GPU constraint. Server footprint ~0.95 GiB (0.92 GiB checkpoint + kv cache capped at 512 tokens via mem-fraction-static 0.06 / max-total-tokens 2048 + profile floor shim).

model.size: 954 MB total (0.92 GiB checkpoint), smallest complete local model; Qwen3-0.6B rejected (no model.safetensors)

launch.startup_result: HEALTHY - /health returned HTTP 200 at t=15s (first probe at t=5s=000, t=10s=000, t=15s=200). ~12 prior launches iterated through the crash chain (each fixed via in-memory shim, no file modified).

message.content: Hello! How can I assist you today

completion.result: PASS - real model-generated completion text returned

completion_debug_note: The chat adapter tokenizes via tokenizer.apply_chat_template(..., tokenize=True) and tokenizer.encode(), both of which return tokenizers.Encoding / transformers BatchEncoding instead of a list of ints in the installed library; sglang 0.3.6 expects lists (slicing via GenerateReqInput.__getitem__ -> self.input_ids[i]). Fixed by shim 14 wrapping both methods on the tokenizer instance at creation (patched hf_transformers_utils.get_tokenizer AND sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager.get_tokenizer module binding - the manager imports the function by name, so patching only the origin module did not take effect).

teardown.method: kill -TERM 1756 then kill -9 (process survived SIGTERM); launcher entry-point finally: kill_child_process() also armed

lane_services_untouched.21080_pheno_serve_proxy: TCP open; GET /v1/models HTTP 200 (/health 404 is its normal route set); untouched
